recipes.name: Exam Era
recipes.template: Create a sophisticated visual story centered around {name}, a {course} student at {school}, during exam season. The image should communicate {emotion} and visually express {message}. The environment should subtly reference the emotional reality of academic pressure while preserving dignity, aspiration and individuality. Apply {style} visual direction with carefully controlled composition, lighting, depth, realistic materials and cinematic detail.

recipes.name: Cinematic Portrait
recipes.template: Create a cinematic portrait representing {name} and the emotional state of {emotion}. The visual should communicate {message} through composition, expression, environment, lighting and subtle visual symbolism.

recipes.name: Product Studio Transformation
recipes.template: Isolate the product from the reference image and rebuild it as a premium advertising composition. Keep the hero product centered and sharply defined, surrounded by relevant supporting ingredients arranged with intention and depth. Use tactile materials, controlled studio lighting, realistic shadows, a background aligned with the product's color palette and mood, visible micro-details, subtle reflections, intentional negative space and polished commercial finishing.
